en.title: Inputting Arrow Scores
en.excerpt: A practical step-by-step guide for target scorekeepers to enter arrow values per end, understand color buttons, and submit scores to the live leaderboard.

toc.text: 2. How to Record Scores Each End

en.content:
🎯
Scorekeeper Note: Stand at the target butt and enter the arrow scores called out by each athlete. The system automatically sorts arrow values in descending order (highest to lowest) and syncs the running totals directly to the public live leaderboard.

1. Keypad Color Buttons & Values

The Archeris keypad matches official World Archery target face ring colors for quick and mistake-free input:

  • Gold Buttons (X & 10): 10 points. X (inner center ring) is tracked separately for tie-breaker calculations.
  • Gold Button (9): 9 points.
  • Red Buttons (8 & 7): 8 and 7 points.
  • Blue Buttons (6 & 5): 6 and 5 points.
  • Black Buttons (4 & 3): 4 and 3 points.
  • White Buttons (2 & 1): 2 and 1 points.
  • Green Button (M): Miss (0 points if an arrow misses the scoring face).

2. How to Record Scores Each End

Follow these quick steps after each shooting end:

  1. Tap the tab for the archer calling their arrows (for example, Archer 1A).
  2. Tap the keypad buttons corresponding to the arrows in the target (e.g., X, 10, 9, 8, 8, 7). The arrow boxes fill in automatically.
  3. Switch to the next archer tabs (1B, 1C, and 1D) and enter their arrows until all archers at the target butt are complete.

3. Correcting Misclicked Arrow Values

If you accidentally tap the wrong button before saving:

  • Simply tap on the specific arrow box that contains the wrong score, then tap the correct number on the keypad to replace it.
  • Tap the Backspace (⌫) button to erase the last arrow value entered.

4. Athlete Verification & Saving the End

Before leaving the target butt:

  1. Show the phone or tablet screen to all archers at the target so they can double-check their end score and cumulative total.
  2. Once everyone agrees, tap the Save & Next End button at the bottom of the screen.
  3. The scores immediately sync with the main tournament server and the public leaderboard updates in real time!

5. Essential Shooting Line Tips

⚠️ Line Cutters (Doubtful Arrows): If an arrow touches a dividing ring line and archers disagree on the value, do not guess or touch the arrows. Call a Line Judge / Referee to make the official ruling before pulling arrows.

📱 Full-Screen App Mode: You can tap Add to Home Screen on your smartphone browser to run the scorekeeper interface in immersive full-screen without URL address bars.

id.title: Penginputan Skor Anak Panah
id.excerpt: Panduan praktis petugas skor bantalan dalam memasukkan nilai anak panah per rambahan, memahami warna tombol keypad, dan mengirim skor ke leaderboard live.
id.content:
🎯
Catatan Petugas Skor: Berdirilah di depan bantalan sasaran dan masukkan nilai anak panah yang disebutkan oleh setiap atlet. Sistem otomatis mengurutkan nilai panah dari yang tertinggi ke terendah dan menyinkronkan skor total ke papan skor live secara real-time.

1. Warna Tombol & Nilai Poin Keypad

Tombol keypad di aplikasi Archeris disesuaikan dengan warna lingkaran target face World Archery:

  • Tombol Emas (X & 10): 10 poin. Nilai X (lingkaran terdalam) dicatat terpisah untuk pemecah seri.
  • Tombol Emas (9): 9 poin.
  • Tombol Merah (8 & 7): 8 dan 7 poin.
  • Tombol Biru (6 & 5): 6 dan 5 poin.
  • Tombol Hitam (4 & 3): 4 dan 3 poin.
  • Tombol Putih (2 & 1): 2 dan 1 poin.
  • Tombol Hijau (M): Miss (0 poin jika panah meleset dari target).

2. Cara Mencatat Skor Setiap Rambahan

Langkah pencatatan nilai di setiap rambahan:

  1. Klik tab atlet yang sedang memanggil nilainya (contoh: Atlet 1A).
  2. Tekan tombol keypad sesuai perolehan panah di bantalan (contoh: X, 10, 9, 8, 8, 7). Kotak panah akan terisi secara otomatis.
  3. Pindah ke tab atlet berikutnya (1B, 1C, dan 1D) hingga seluruh pemanah di bantalan selesai dicatat.

3. Memperbaiki Salah Klik Nilai Panah

Jika salah menekan tombol sebelum disimpan:

  • Cukup klik pada kotak anak panah yang salah, lalu tekan angka yang benar pada keypad.
  • Gunakan tombol Backspace (⌫) untuk menghapus nilai panah terakhir yang dimasukkan.

4. Verifikasi Atlet & Menyimpan Rambahan

Sebelum mencabut anak panah:

  1. Tunjukkan layar smartphone/tablet kepada seluruh pemanah di bantalan untuk konfirmasi nilai rambahan dan total skor berjalan.
  2. Setelah seluruh atlet setuju, klik tombol Simpan & Lanjut Rambahan Berikutnya.
  3. Skor otomatis terkirim ke server dan leaderboard turnamen langsung terupdate!

5. Tips Penting di Garis Sasaran

⚠️ Panah Garis (Line Cutters): Jika anak panah menyentuh garis pembatas lingkaran dan atlet ragu mengenai nilainya, jangan mencabut panah. Panggil Wasit Lapangan (Judge) untuk menentukan keputusan resmi sebelum anak panah dicabut.
